scripts.render: node scripts/stamp.ts && remotion render src/index.ts VgiExplainer out/raw.mp4 && scripts/master.sh out/raw.mp4 out/vgi-explainer.mp4 && node scripts/captions.ts
scripts.assets: python3 scripts/eleven.py voiceover && python3 scripts/eleven.py normalize
scripts.kit: node scripts/youtube.ts && remotion still src/index.ts Thumbnail out/youtube/thumbnail.png && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/youtube/thumbnail.png -q:v 2 out/youtube/thumbnail.jpg && rm out/youtube/thumbnail.png && cp scripts/UPLOAD.md out/youtube/
scripts.readme-thumb: remotion still src/index.ts ReadmeThumbnail out/video-thumbnail.png && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/video-thumbnail.png -q:v 3 out/video-thumbnail.jpg && rm out/video-thumbnail.png
